fact_text: PMEX offers gold futures with an expiry date and initial margin, and physical spot gold bought in full payment, which has no expiry and no initial margin.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: A milli-tola gold contract is one-thousandth of a tola, so half a tola is bought as 500 milli-tola contracts and a quarter tola as 250.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: In the presenter's illustration, a milli-tola contract worth PKR 400 at PKR 4 lakh per tola requires about PKR 500 initial margin, with the PKR 100 excess returned on settlement.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: Tola gold contracts trade from the Monday market open to Wednesday 4 pm, and the second contract runs from Wednesday 4 pm until Friday market close, when trading stops.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The Monday tola contract settles at Friday session close, and the Wednesday contract settles on the Tuesday session, with any balance payable on Saturday, Sunday or Monday.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: PMEX issued gold trading-timing notices on 23 Sep 2025, 21 Oct 2025 and 2 Dec 2025, and traders are told to check the timings and settlement dates against them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: A trader can demand physical delivery of tola gold on PMEX once cumulative holdings reach 10 tola, either partially or in one lot.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The domestic physical gold segment trades milli-tola and tola contracts in practice, while the mini-gold contract is listed but not traded.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: A buy-limit order placed at a chosen price executes automatically when the market reaches that price, and profit and loss is adjusted nightly until the contract expires.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: After settlement, the buyer can move the gold into the PMEX electronic vault (E-Vault) within the payment window that runs to the following Tuesday.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The presenter says rising gold price volatility is pushing more clients toward physical gold trading on PMEX.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Spot Gold Trading on PMEX | E-Vault, Settlement & Delivery | Gold Starting from Rs. 500' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)
